codex.ssc-extras.instincts_2: You sense that indulging your instincts further could make this transformation permanent. Refraining from them lets your instincts gradually subside.
info.ssc-extras.inhibitor_calmed_instinc: Your instinct eases. Your form remains unchanged.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.cursed: Binds itself to cursed wearers. Curses an uncursed wearer.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.release: Remove at permanent form, or use an Inhibitor at original form with zero instinct.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.infuse: Craft with a curse potion to infuse its form.
screen.ssc-extras.effigy.tool_use: Empty hand: strip / make paths; sneak to till.
slot.ssc-extras.head: Helmet infusion
screen.ssc-extras.effigy.empty_hand: Works with an empty main hand.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ti: The curse has left its first marks on your skin. Beneath the scattered scales, your body still feels familiar.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ap:
Running your fingers over your skin, you find small patches of hard, earthy scales. Brown and olive patches mark your forehead, back and limbs, while paler scales emerge down your chest and abdomen. Much of your skin is still visible between them.
Your nose and mouth have pushed forward into a short, blunt muzzle. Above it, two small horns break through the scales on your forehead; their unfamiliar weight is noticeable whenever you tilt your head.
A stubby tail extends from the base of your spine. You can feel it shift as you turn, though you have yet to grow accustomed to having something follow every movement of your hips.
Small, dark points protrude from your fingers and toes, the beginnings of claws. Your hands and feet otherwise retain their familiar shape.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.pr: Your changing digestion draws as much nourishment from raw food as from their cooked versions.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.co: Your growing horns and tail prevent helmets and leggings from fitting your altered body.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.in: You begin to crave raw food, and they seem appetizing. Each raw meal strengthens the urge to give in to the changes.

codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ti: The changes are becoming harder to conceal. Your growing frame carries a strength that your human body never had.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ap:
The scattered scales have spread across your shoulders, flanks and limbs, joining into broader patches. A pale strip is taking shape along your chest and belly, framed by darker scales across your back. Exposed skin still shows through the gaps.
Your neck lengthens beneath your head, and your muzzle projects farther from your face. The horns above your brow have thickened and begun to sweep backward, giving your still-familiar head a distinctly draconic outline.
Your hands and feet have broadened, each bearing three sturdy, dark claws. You can still curl your fingers around a handle, but the hard tips now brush against everything you grasp.
Your growing body stands two blocks tall. Behind you, the tail has lengthened into a flexible, tapering counterweight; you feel it shift to steady you when you turn or lean forward.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.pr:
Your sturdier frame grants 1 additional heart, and your hardening scales provide 3 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws deal 3 damage and dig with the speed and harvesting strength of stone tools.
Your stronger jaws let you eat 50% faster. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.co: Helmets and leggings cannot accommodate your horns and tail. Your broad, clawed feet have also outgrown boots.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw food tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_1.d:

Your neck lengthens beneath your head, and your muzzle projects farther from your face. The horns above your brow have thickened and begun to sweep backward, giving your still-familiar head a distinctly draconic outline.
Your hands and feet have broadened, each bearing three sturdy, dark claws. You can still curl your fingers around a handle, but the hard tips now brush against everything you grasp.
Your growing body stands two blocks tall. Behind you, the tail has lengthened into a flexible, tapering counterweight; you feel it shift to steady you when you turn or lean forward.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ti: Standing upright takes an unfamiliar effort. Whenever you break into a run, your body knows another way to move.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ap:
Earthy scales now cover most of your body, with pale plates running from your throat down your chest and abdomen. Your neck slopes forward beneath a heavier head, and your broadening muzzle and swept horns leave little of your old face recognizable.
Your heels lift from the ground as your lower legs lengthen into a digitigrade shape. Your weight rests on broad, clawed toes, while a thick tail extends behind your hips to balance your forward-leaning torso. Even hunched, you stand 2.2 blocks tall.
Your thumbs have receded, leaving three thick, clawed digits on each hand. Pads have formed beneath them, and pressing your palms to the ground feels increasingly natural. What used to be hands are becoming weight-bearing paws.
As you begin to sprint, your shoulders drop and your forepaws meet the ground. Your limbs settle into a four-footed stride, the heavy tail following each turn. You can still rise into a hunched stance, but running belongs to all four limbs now.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.pr:
Your powerful build grants 4 additional hearts and 50% knockback resistance. Thick scales provide 15 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like iron tools and strike with the base damage of an iron sword (6). Your strength increases all melee damage by 25%. An infused weapon supplies its own damage in place of your natural claws.
Running on all fours increases your sprinting speed by 20%.
You eat twice as fast. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.co:
Your altered proportions no longer fit any armor. Without thumbs, you cannot keep hold of tools, weapons, shields or fishing rods; they slip free, as does anything placed in your offhand. You carry other items in your mouth.
When hunger falls to 3 drumsticks or less, you can no longer maintain your upright stance and must walk on all fours until you have eaten enough.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw meat, fish and potatoes tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.

codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ti: A broad, horned shape moves across the earth on four heavy paws. The drake you have become feels entirely at home in its own skin.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ap:
Your body has settled into the broad, low shape of a wingless drake. Olive-brown scales cover your back and flanks, giving way to pale, stone-colored plates along your throat, chest and belly. Your deep torso hangs between powerful shoulders and muscular haunches.
A thick, plated neck supports your heavy head. Your muzzle has broadened into a blunt snout above a deep lower jaw; dark horns sweep back from your brow, with smaller spurs framing your cheeks. 
Your former arms are now sturdy forelegs. All four paws rest on three thick toes, with firm pads underneath and dark talons extending from their tips. Raised heels and angled joints support your weight in a fully quadrupedal stance.
A heavy tail tapers behind you, moving with your spine as you walk.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.pr:
Your fully developed body grants 6 additional hearts, followed by a 10% bonus increase to maximum health. Your heavy build provides 50% knockback resistance.
Your dense scales now reduce incoming damage by 75%, replacing the need for armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like diamond tools and strike with the base damage of a diamond sword (7). Your strength increases all melee damage by another 50%.
Your four-footed stride increases sprinting speed by 20%. You eat twice as fast, gaining cooked-food nourishment from raw food.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.co:
Your body can only move on all fours. Your bulkier build is too broad for passages only one block wide.
No armor fits your frame, and your paws cannot hold tools or weapons.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_3.d:

A thick, plated neck supports your heavy head. Your muzzle has broadened into a blunt snout above a deep lower jaw; dark horns sweep back from your brow, with smaller spurs framing your cheeks. The proportions of your old face have disappeared beneath them.
Your former arms are now sturdy forelegs. All four paws rest on three thick toes, with firm pads underneath and dark talons extending from their tips. Raised heels and angled joints support your weight in a fully quadrupedal stance.
A heavy tail tapers behind you, moving with your spine as you walk.
